# OpenVidu

> From ready-to-use video conferencing apps<br>to custom-made WebRTC solutions.<br>Self-hosted. Performant. Scalable. Fault tolerant. Observable.

Self-hosted videoconference solution and SDK

> The pages that are not tied to a version — pricing, support, the product comparisons and the blog — are listed in https://openvidu.io/llms.txt.

## OpenVidu Meet

- [Getting started with OpenVidu Meet](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/getting-started/index.md): First steps with OpenVidu Meet: run it locally, log in, create a room, hold and record a meeting, and see how to embed Meet in your app.
- [OpenVidu Meet](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/index.md): Self-hosted video conferencing, ready to use: deploy OpenVidu Meet on your servers in minutes, record meetings and embed video calls in any app.
- [OpenVidu Meet release notes](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/releases/index.md): Release notes for every OpenVidu Meet version, with the changelog of new features, breaking changes and upgrade notes.

## OpenVidu Meet features

- [Recordings](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/features/recordings/index.md): Record OpenVidu Meet meetings as a moderator, then view, share by link and manage the recordings of each room, with per-room recording settings.
- [Rooms and meetings in OpenVidu Meet](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/features/rooms-and-meetings/index.md): Understand the difference between rooms and meetings in OpenVidu Meet, and learn how to
- [Users and permissions](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/features/users-and-permissions/index.md): Participant roles in an OpenVidu Meet room, how moderators change them during a meeting, and the administrator login that protects Meet.

## OpenVidu Meet deployment

- [Scalable and fault-tolerant Meet deployments](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/deployment/advanced/index.md): Compare OpenVidu Meet deployment types and choose Elastic or High Availability when a single server is no longer enough for your user load.
- [Deploy OpenVidu Meet on a single server](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/deployment/basic/index.md): Production deployment of OpenVidu Meet on one Linux server: prerequisites, ports, domain and TLS certificates, and the installer command.
- [Try OpenVidu Meet locally](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/deployment/local/index.md): Deploy OpenVidu Meet on your local machine for development and testing purposes using Docker Desktop.
- [OpenVidu Meet deployment overview](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/deployment/overview/index.md): OpenVidu offers a self-hosted, production-ready live-video platform with advanced capabilities, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and observability.

## OpenVidu Meet embedding

- [OpenVidu Meet Embedded](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/intro/index.md): Add video calls to your own application with a single line of HTML, as a URL, an iframe or the OpenVidu Meet Web Component, plus a REST API and webhooks.
- [Step by step guide](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/step-by-step-guide/index.md): Embed OpenVidu Meet in your web app step by step: run the server, create a room, choose an embedding option and deploy your application.

## OpenVidu Meet embedding tutorials

- [OpenVidu Meet Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/tutorials/index.md): Learn how to build a video conferencing application by easily integrating OpenVidu Meet into your web application.
- [OpenVidu Meet Direct Link Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/tutorials/direct-link/index.md): Learn how to build a video conferencing application using Node.js and JavaScript by easily using a direct link to OpenVidu Meet.
- [OpenVidu Meet Recordings Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/tutorials/recordings/index.md): Learn how to manage recordings in a video conferencing application using Node.js and JavaScript by extending the advanced OpenVidu Meet WebComponent tutorial.
- [OpenVidu Meet WebComponent Commands & Events Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/tutorials/webcomponent-advanced/index.md): Learn how to build a video conferencing application using Node.js and JavaScript by integrating OpenVidu Meet WebComponent with advanced commands and event handling.
- [OpenVidu Meet WebComponent Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/tutorials/webcomponent/index.md): Learn how to build a video conferencing application using Node.js and JavaScript by easily integrating OpenVidu Meet WebComponent.
- [OpenVidu Meet Webhooks Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/tutorials/webhooks/index.md): Learn how to build a real-time video conferencing application using Node.js and JavaScript with live updates through webhooks and Server-Sent Events.

## OpenVidu Meet API reference

- [Embed OpenVidu Meet with a direct link](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/reference/direct-link/index.md): Send participants to an OpenVidu Meet room with a plain HTML link, and fetch room access URLs from your backend with the REST API.
- [Embed OpenVidu Meet in an iframe](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/reference/iframe/index.md): Embed OpenVidu Meet with a standard HTML iframe, including the permissions the browser needs for camera, microphone and screen sharing.
- [OpenVidu Meet REST API reference](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/reference/rest-api/index.md): Manage rooms and recordings from your backend with the OpenVidu Meet REST API, with API key authentication and ready-made code snippets.
- [OpenVidu Meet Web Component reference](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/reference/webcomponent/index.md): Embed the OpenVidu Meet interface with the openvidu-meet Web Component, and drive it from your app with its attributes, commands and events.
- [OpenVidu Meet webhooks reference](https://openvidu.io/3.5/meet/embedded/reference/webhooks/index.md): Receive meeting and recording events from OpenVidu Meet in your backend, and verify webhook signatures before acting on them.

- [OpenVidu vs LiveKit, Jitsi, SaaS and SFUs](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/comparing-openvidu/index.md): Compare OpenVidu with LiveKit, SaaS solutions, SFUs and more to understand its advantages, unique features and benefits over other video conferencing tools.
- [Developing your OpenVidu app](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/developing-your-openvidu-app/index.md): Learn how to build and deploy your OpenVidu application.
- [How to develop your OpenVidu app](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/developing-your-openvidu-app/how-to/index.md): Explore common OpenVidu operations for developing your application, from managing rooms to publishing tracks.
- [OpenVidu Platform](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/index.md): Learn how to get started with OpenVidu, a powerful platform for building real-time applications, including video conferencing, AI, live streaming and robotics.
- [OpenVidu Platform release notes](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/releases/index.md): Explore the latest OpenVidu releases, including new features, updates and bug fixes for each version of the platform.
- [OpenVidu Angular Components](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ui-components/angular-components/index.md): OpenVidu Angular Components simplify the creation of videoconferencing apps, offering customizable and powerful components for rapid development and easy maintenance.
- [React Components for OpenVidu apps](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ui-components/react-components/index.md): LiveKit React Components simplify real-time audio/video app development with ready-to-use components, hooks and contexts for seamless integration.

## OpenVidu Platform tutorials — application server

- [Application Server Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/index.md): Learn how to build an application server that generates LiveKit tokens and receives webhook events.
- [.NET Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/dotnet/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal .NET application server with ASP.NET to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit .NET SDK.
- [Go Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/go/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal Go application server with Gin to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit Go SDK.
- [Java Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/java/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal Java application server with Spring Boot to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit Kotlin SDK.
- [Node.js Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/node/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal Node.js server with Express to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit JS SDK.
- [PHP Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/php/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal PHP server to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit PHP SDK.
- [Python Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/python/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal Python application server with Flask to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit Python SDK.
- [Ruby Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/ruby/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal Ruby application server with Sinatra to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit Ruby SDK.
- [Rust Server Tutorial](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/tutorials/application-server/rust/index.md): Learn how to build a minimal Rust application server with Axum to generate LiveKit tokens and receive webhook events using the LiveKit Rust SDK.

## OpenVidu Platform AI services

- [Build a custom AI agent for OpenVidu](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ai/custom-agents/index.md): Write, dockerize and deploy your own AI agent into OpenVidu rooms with the LiveKit Agents framework, in Python or Node.
- [Live Captions: real-time speech to text](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ai/live-captions/index.md): Transcribe room audio in real time and display live captions in your frontend, with the speech-to-text provider you configure for your deployment.
- [AI services for OpenVidu rooms](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ai/overview/index.md): Catalog of ready-to-use AI services for OpenVidu rooms, from live captions to transcription and translation, provided by pre-configured OpenVidu agents.
- [OpenVidu agents dispatch](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ai/openvidu-agents/agent-dispatch/index.md): Control which rooms an OpenVidu agent joins: automatic dispatch into every new room, or explicit dispatch driven by your own application.
- [OpenVidu agents overview](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ai/openvidu-agents/overview/index.md): How OpenVidu agents work: pre-configured AI modules that run as Docker containers on your own nodes and are enabled declaratively with a YAML file.
- [Speech Processing agent](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/ai/openvidu-agents/speech-processing-agent/index.md): Enable and configure the Speech Processing agent to turn room speech into text, and choose the transcription provider for your deployment.

- [OpenVidu Elastic](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/elastic/index.md): Learn how to install OpenVidu Elastic on-premises or on AWS, with configuration and management guides for each deployment option.
- [OpenVidu High Availability](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/ha/index.md): Learn how to install OpenVidu High Availability on-premises or on AWS, with configuration and management guides for each deployment option.
- [OpenVidu Local installation](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/local/index.md): Learn how to install OpenVidu locally for development with Docker Compose. Quickly set up a secure environment to test and build your applications.
- [OpenVidu Single Node Pro](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/single-node-pro/index.md): Learn how to install, configure and administer OpenVidu Single Node Pro On Premises, AWS or Azure.

## OpenVidu Platform production readiness

- [Production ready](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/index.md): OpenVidu offers a self-hosted, production-ready live-video platform with advanced capabilities, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and observability.
- [Fault tolerance in OpenVidu deployments](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/fault-tolerance/index.md): Ensure seamless real-time media experiences with OpenVidu's fault tolerance. Handle node failures effortlessly with Elastic and High Availability deployments.
- [OpenVidu performance: 2x with mediasoup](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/performance/index.md): Discover how OpenVidu boosts performance with mediasoup, doubling media track capacity per server while maintaining seamless LiveKit compatibility.
- [OpenVidu scalability and autoscaling](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/scalability/index.md): Scale effortlessly with OpenVidu's elastic deployments, handling small meetings to massive live streams, with autoscaling and high availability support.
- [Observability](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/observability/index.md): OpenVidu provides all the tools you need to monitor and analyze your deployment in real-time using OpenVidu Dashboard and a Grafana stack.
- [Grafana stack for OpenVidu metrics and logs](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/observability/grafana-stack/index.md): Monitor OpenVidu Server metrics and cluster logs with Grafana's powerful dashboards, integrating Prometheus, Mimir and Loki for complete observability.
- [OpenVidu Dashboard: live room monitoring](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/observability/openvidu-dashboard/index.md): Access real-time video room statistics and monitoring with OpenVidu Dashboard. Track rooms, participants, egresses and ingresses.

## OpenVidu Platform how-to guides and troubleshooting

- [How To Guides](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/index.md): Explore step-by-step guides to customize your OpenVidu deployment for specific use cases
- [Backup and restore OpenVidu deployments](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/backup-and-restore/index.md): Learn how to safeguard OpenVidu recordings, observability metrics, and operational data by backing up and restoring MinIO/S3 storage and MongoDB across all deployment models.
- [Create AWS certificate for HA deployment](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/create-configure-AWS-certificate/index.md): Learn how to create an AWS certificate for OpenVidu HA deployment, including domain setup, CNAME record creation and Load Balancer configuration
- [Deploy OpenVidu behind an external proxy](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/deploy-with-external-proxy/index.md): Run OpenVidu behind a reverse proxy you already operate instead of its bundled Caddy server, on Single Node, Elastic and High Availability.
- [Enable and disable OpenVidu modules](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/enable-disable-modules/index.md): Learn how to enable or disable OpenVidu modules to customize your deployment configuration.
- [Enable and disable the bundled MongoDB](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/enable-disable-mongodb/index.md): Learn how to enable or disable the bundled MongoDB service used by OpenVidu services such as Dashboard, Meet, and analytics storage.
- [Enable OpenVidu webhooks](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/enable-webhooks/index.md): Learn how to enable webhooks in OpenVidu to integrate with other services and receive event notifications from your deployment.
- [Use an external MongoDB with OpenVidu](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/external-mongodb/index.md): Configure OpenVidu to use an external MongoDB deployment instead of the bundled database instance.
- [Configuring external S3 for OpenVidu recordings](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/external-s3/index.md): Learn how to configure OpenVidu with an external S3 provider for recording storage.
- [Force traffic through 443 with TLS](https://openvidu.io/3.5/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/force-443-tls/index.md): Learn how to force all OpenVidu traffic, including WebRTC, through port 443 with TLS for enhanced security and compatibility with restrictive networks.
